name: CoolDock
summary: Mac app that adds a second Dock with 160+ live widgets: music, calendar, weather, todos, system stats and quick actions.
description: CoolDock adds a customizable second Dock beside the macOS Dock, filled with 160+ live widgets — apps and folders, Pomodoro and reminders, calendar, weather, music, system stats, clipboard, screenshots, plus business and developer widgets. Widgets can be arranged in dock profiles with floating layouts, wallpapers and appearance settings. One-time purchase; requires macOS Sonoma 14.0 or later.
contains: 160+ widgets for Mac, from clocks and weather to AI usage, revenue and files
widget groups: apps and files, productivity, system controls, creator tools, business metrics, developer tools
dock profiles, floating layouts and wallpapers
pricing: €14.99 one-year license, €29.99+ lifetime (per device), €99.99 forever edition for 5 Macs
